description: The Applications board under its filters: how many applications stand in each bucket, how many are being worked on now, and light rows of one bucket's page or of the first rows of every bucket, work running now first. Paging with offset needs bucket. Reads only.

before.description: Only applications recorded before this ISO date.

bucket.description: One bucket to page through; leave it out for the first rows of every bucket.

company.description: Only applications at this employer, matched without case.

offset.description: Rows to skip for the next page: the previous page's coverage names the offset to pass.

q.description: Words to match in the job title or employer.

since.description: Only applications recorded on or after this ISO date.

name: get_application_board

bucket.description: The column paged through, or null when every column's first rows came back.

counts.description: How many applications stand in each board column, under the filters.

coverage.description: What this page covers, so the assistant can say honestly what it read.

complete.description: True when this page holds every matching row and no earlier page was skipped.

empty_reason.description: Why nothing came back, when the page is empty; null when it holds rows.

gaps.description: What this result does not hold, one entry per gap.

items.description: One kind of row this result does not hold.

kind.description: Why the row is missing: "page" for later rows, "earlier_pages" for rows before this page, "filtered" for rows a filter left out.

what.description: The gap in words: the offset to ask for next, or what was filtered out.

line.description: One sentence saying what this page holds, what was left out and what was not read; show it to the user as it is.

total.description: How many rows the filters match in all, when that is known.

filters.description: The filters this page was read under.

before.description: The ISO date applications were recorded before.

q.description: The words matched in the job title or employer.

since.description: The ISO date applications were recorded on or after.

offset.description: The offset this page starts at.

rows.description: The light rows of one column's page, or the first rows of every column.

items.description: One light application row of the board.

awaiting_fix.description: True while ApplySent is fixing a problem on its side before retrying.

brand_color.description: The employer's brand colour, when one is known.

bucket.description: The board column this application stands in.

company_domain.description: The employer's domain, when the catalogue resolved one.

job_id.description: The job id of this application.

remote.description: Whether the posting is remote, when the catalogue established it.

logo_url.description: The employer's logo URL, when one is known.

questions.description: How many employer questions wait on the user for this application.

reason_code.description: A stable code for why the application stands where it does.

retryable.description: True when the user may send this application again.

stage.description: The hiring stage the employer's messages established, when known.

stage_at.description: When the current stage was reached, ISO 8601.

step.description: What an application in progress is doing or waiting for; null for a column that reports no step.

board_hold.description: True when the employer is holding this board until a time.

label.description: What the application is doing or waiting for, in words.

live.description: True while work on this application is running now.

uncertain.description: True when the send went out without a confirmed receipt.

updated_at.description: When the application last changed, ISO 8601.

working.description: How many applications are being worked on right now.

title: Read the application board
